summary: The package extension's render leg reaches all seven declared fields and its parse leg five — no case anywhere parses a `notes` or a `contractTouching` value, so two announced schemas are unexercised

per.section: A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote

acceptance: the case driving the package's declaration through both engine surfaces hands the parser an entry carrying a value for every field the declaration names, asserted against that declaration's own key set ahead of the parse, so the parse leg's claim reaches the set the render leg's already does
pins: parsePendingQueue accepts an entry carrying a value for every field the package's entry extension declares
a notes value past the package's cap is refused through the real parser
notes: Verified on disk: `entryQueue` (`tests/harnessEntryExtension.test.ts:47`-`:62`) values nine keys and never `notes` or `contractTouching`, while `:73`'s render loop is derived from `entryExtension()` and its parse leg takes that one fixture. `:149` asserts the omission parses, never a value. `ENTRY_CAPS.notes` (`harness/entryExtension.ts:41`, enforced `:163`) has no at-cap/past-cap pair beside `summary`'s (`:136`, `:142`). `fe5344e1` reverted a plan commit on that cap.
